<h1>Good Practice Guide on Emissivity Conversion Published</h1>

<p>A <strong>Good Practice Guide</strong> on the conversion of near-normal directional emissivity into hemispherical emissivity has been published by Manara, Monte, and collaborators from PTB.</p>

<p>This guide addresses one of the most common practical challenges in emissivity measurement: how to reliably convert between directional and hemispherical quantities. The document provides:</p>

<ul>
<li>Theoretical background on the relationship between directional and hemispherical emissivity</li>
<li>Practical conversion procedures with worked examples</li>
<li>Uncertainty analysis guidance</li>
<li>Recommended best practices for reporting</li>
</ul>

<p>The guide is freely available on Zenodo and represents an important step toward standardized practices in our field.</p>
